findings.title: 转蛋合法换队被固定席位机器人适配器拒绝，自动重试最终进入关房
findings.evidence: teamForSeat永久以玩家ID p1/p3为A、p2/p4为B。真实createRoomOpeningState→arrangeRotatingRound会保持认证ID但调整turnOrder并重分team；随机换队52个固定seed中22个实际改变队伍，四个席位共88次chooseCards均在validateTable抛错。顺时针从正常首局经真实prepareNextRound产生第二局turnOrder[p3,p2,p4,p1]，同样不符合固定映射。weapp-match-lifecycle:329机器人/托管共用该适配器；371-375默认3次重试后83-86调用closeRoomWithoutAck。
findings.validation: node docs/audit/2026-09-12/repro/runtime-policy-13.mjs：实际opening/arrange/choose/prepare/arm/automatedDeadline代码与内存时钟/持久端口。随机或顺时针×bot或manual trustee×当前或JSON canonical恢复共8例均零revision推进、3条队伍数据错误、close端口收到automated-deadline-failed/roomDissolved/dissolved。定局和顺时针第一局×bot/trustee四对照真实合法出牌，未关房。
findings.impact: 合法换队后的转蛋房，只要轮到机器人或已进入托管的玩家自动出牌，决策失败并触发异常关房流程；真人手动出牌未通过此路径，不因此一并判定失败。未重建真实微信连接、存储断电或观察线上事故；close端口捕获关房请求而非真实外部广播。52seed计数不是线上发生率。
findings.recommendation: 校验权威turnOrder是四个合法ID的排列，并按当前物理位置/当前队伍分组验证一队两人、对家同队，使用state.players[playerId].team作为AI队伍；不要仅删除校验或继续用固定ID推队友。保留认证ID绑定与隐藏牌边界。加转蛋抽牌实际重排、顺时针第二/三局、真人托管/机器人、恢复后继续自动出牌的端到端回归；验证普通固定队伍与非法不一致状态仍正确拒绝。

probe.result: 182 public openings, 240 friend settings, 48 clocks, 48 timing fixtures, 12 hidden-view/legal controls passed. 52 draw seeds yielded 22 dynamically regrouped tables/88 rejected bot seats; 8 actual lifecycle failure paths and 4 normal controls reproduce RP-13-001.

limitations: No product changes/build/commit/deployment. All selected files full-read; auxiliaries already covered or not counted.
Draw seed ratio is deterministic diagnostic sample, not population prevalence; clockwise settlement manually supplied before real next-round path, not a full game played.
Actual bot/core/lifecycle modules are used, but persistence, publication, queue scheduling clocks and final close callback are synthetic; no real websocket client or phone.
No new claim about legacy corrupted snapshots, strict input bypass, algorithm optimality or platform startup credential behavior.
Existing tests green do not cover rotated identity vs physical seat invariants; source-backed cross-module failure is retained, not fixed under audit authority.
